title: E2E.Test.Obfuscated.Retry.Reprobe.2024.1080p-TESTGRP
description: Primary serves a corrupted obfuscated RAR with no PAR2 while backup serves a clean obfuscated 7z. Under conservative primary-first retries, file-level corruption no longer proves the primary server is bad, so the job is expected to fail instead of switching to backup automatically.
